slicer.name: Snapmaker Orca
slicer._notes: Printer preset name and retraction default (1.5 mm @ 30 mm/s) are from Snapmaker's official U1 machine preset in github.com/Snapmaker/OrcaSlicer. With inheritOfficialPresets, exported presets inherit the matching official Snapmaker filament preset so Snapmaker's other settings carry over; set it to false to export standalone presets.
